payload.artist_html: M. A. White, J. J. Bevitt, K. W. Petersen & M. C. Herne
payload.credit_html: "Tenuicruris piscanexum, a new addition to Australia’s rare Cretaceous bird fossils"
payload.description_html: Left tibiotarsus of Tenuicruris piscanexum, (KK F1451) in: A, in situ medial view; B, medial; C; cranial; D, lateral; E, caudal; F, proximal (with distal end projection); G, proximal; H, distal (with proximal end projection); I, distal views. Right tarsometatarsus KKF1452: J, in situ plantar view; K, plantar aspect with cross-sections (1–6); L, cranial; M, medial; N, lateral; O, proximal; P, distal views. Abbreviations: ap, ascending process of the astragalus; cafc, caudal cnemial crest; crfc, cranial cnemial crest; eri, extensor retinaculum insertions; es, extensor sulcus; fh, fibula head; lc, lateral condyle; lf, lateral fossa; mc, medial condyle; med, medial epicondylar depression; mf, medial fossa; mr, medial ridge; ms, medial sulcus.
